_doc: Governorate normalisation and site definitions. 'governorate_aliases' maps the raw 'City' values from the source to a canonical governorate (keys are compared case-insensitively after trimming). A value like 'Dakahlia - Mansoura' that is not listed is split on ' - ': the left part is the governorate and the right part becomes the area. 'sites' define what each build contains; build with: python scripts/build.py --site <name>.
